responsibility: Declares the decimal floating-point helper API used by GCC’s real-number handling. It exposes encoding/decoding of decimal32/64/128 formats, decimal arithmetic and comparison routines, conversions to and from strings, integer-conversion helpers, format rounding/conversion entry points, and mode-based max-value construction for decimal REAL_VALUE_TYPE values.
same_name_distinction: Exposes the decimal floating-point API for encoding, decoding, arithmetic, formatting, and integer conversion of REAL_VALUE_TYPE values; unlike gcc/dfp.cc, it is only the declaration surface for those decimal support routines.
